_: THE CHECKOUT'S DEVICE AND NETWORK, READ ONE WAY IN TWO REPOS. The Shopify app (Ink-Shopify-Dashboard app/services/checkout-client.vectors.json) reduces Shopify's client_details at enrol; the backend (utils/checkoutClient.js) reads each open's user agent and keeps each open's network prefix (utils/proxyTriage.js ipPrefixOf). Both files are this file, byte for byte: a comparison is only a comparison when both sides read the same way. device = the record's device word (the-ritualist src/lib/order-record-export.ts deviceLabel).
